scenes.say: Some companies pay hackers to break into their own systems. That's a red team.
scenes.title: Paid to hack you

scenes.say: The red team attacks like real criminals. The blue team defends and tries to catch them.
They use the same tools as attackers, like Nmap, to scan for open doors.
One phishing email opens a laptop, then a file server, then the domain controller.
Every attack follows a chain. Recon. Get in. Move deeper. Take the data.
scenes.title: the attack chain

scenes.say: Why bother? The average data breach costs about 4.4 million dollars.
scenes.label: average cost of a data breach

scenes.say: A red team breaks in first, so real attackers can't.
scenes.title: Break in before they do
